target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28, AWS-certified; AWS SDE intern, Capital One SWE intern, Amazon contract work. Heavy AWS/full-stack keywords, but dense 3-line bullets bury the wins.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Results arrive at the end of long tech chains; several bullets (AWS, Leo deploy, Bedrock, IEX) have no stated outcome at all.
score_rationale.quantification: Good numbers exist (65%, 34%, 20,000+) but 90% satisfaction and 93% meal satisfaction lack sample size/baseline; many bullets unquantified.
score_rationale.technical_depth: Real engineering visible, but bullets stack 4–6 services each, reading partly as AWS keyword soup rather than decisions.
score_rationale.concision_readability: Many 3-line bullets, 3–5 bold terms per bullet, long run-on clauses joined by 'with ... with'; body text small and dense.
score_rationale.skim_test: Brands and titles pop, but headline wins are buried mid-bullet and bold noise competes with them.
score_rationale.credibility: Four concurrent 'Present' roles plus an on-site Redmond internship and an overlapping summer project invite timeline questions.
score_rationale.ats_parseability: Phone is a placeholder, month formats inconsistent (Sep vs June/August), 'Digital Badge' sits in a location column, skills miscategorized.
score_rationale.visual_layout: Full-bleed density, small font, contact line wraps, no spacing before EXPERIENCE heading; otherwise aligned and consistent.
score_rationale.domain_fit: Strong general-SWE evidence, but certification precedes experience and the strongest backend/systems bullets are not surfaced first.
score_rationale.overall: Brands carry it past screens; density and timeline overlap cost points with human reviewers and LLM screeners.

must_fix: Replace the '(XXX) XXX-XXXX' placeholder with a real phone number (or remove it) — parsers populate the phone field with garbage.
Standardize date format: use one month style everywhere (e.g., 'Jun 2026 – Aug 2026' to match 'Sep 2026 – Dec 2026').
Clarify: how the AWS SDE intern role (Redmond, Sep–Dec 2026) coexists with three 'Present' College Park roles; mark paused/part-time roles or set end dates.
Clarify: employer for the contract role — 'Amazon (via UMD App Development Contracting)' may parse as Amazon employment; state the actual employer and client explicitly.
Move 'Digital Badge' out of the right-aligned location column (embed the link on the cert name) so it is not parsed as a location.
Fix skills miscategorization: SQS is not observability; CloudFormation/CDK are infrastructure-as-code, not CI/CD.
Cut every bullet to ≤2 lines and ≤2 bold anchors (Capital One ×3, Bedrock bullet currently run 3 lines).

bullets.quote: Researching and implementing Java-based utilization optimizations for
bullets.issue: Vague single bullet for the top brand; no what/why; present-progressive with no outcome.
bullets.suggestion: Clarify with the candidate what is being optimized (e.g., which Redshift component/resource) before adding detail; keep 'Java' and 'Amazon Redshift' as keywords.

bullets.quote: Overhauled the legacy UI of a test data
bullets.issue: 3 lines, 5 bolded techs; 90% satisfaction lacks a sample/baseline and comes last.
bullets.suggestion: Rebuilt a legacy test-data workflow editor in React + Electron with TypeScript state validation and Jest tests on mock workflows; 90% internal satisfaction vs. the legacy tool.

bullets.quote: Engineered a lightweight tree-style workflow search index
bullets.issue: 3 lines; result (fewer DB queries) is stated as intent only; Node.js IPC tail adds noise.
bullets.suggestion: Built a precomputed tree-style search index over a 270,000+ row PostgreSQL table (Python + SQLAlchemy), with Redis caching for workflow retrieval, minimizing database queries under access constraints.

bullets.quote: Developed a Claude skill for workflow generation,
bullets.issue: Strongest metric buried at line 3; 'Claude skill' is jargon an LLM/ATS screener may not map.
bullets.suggestion: Cut LLM workflow-generation time 65% to under 15s by decomposing a Claude agent skill into Python search/validation sub-skills, using CloudWatch + OpenSearch latency logs to find bottlenecks.

bullets.quote: Deployed an Amazon Leo space topic research
bullets.issue: No outcome beyond 'adopted'; 'space topic research utility' is unclear; tech list dominates.
bullets.suggestion: Deployed a research utility adopted into Amazon Leo's ecosystem on Docker + AWS Fargate, with GitHub Actions CI/CD and AWS CDK (TypeScript) infrastructure so unfamiliar engineers could contribute.

bullets.quote: Achieved a 34% speedup on a pipeline
bullets.issue: Good lead metric; Lambda named twice and trailing API Gateway clause dilutes it.
bullets.suggestion: Achieved a 34% speedup routing 6,000+ scraped research documents to inference by moving to Kinesis streams feeding Lambda processors, fronted by API Gateway for app integration.

bullets.quote: Integrated automated fine-tuning of an AWS Bedrock
bullets.issue: 3 lines, five AWS services, no result; reads as service inventory.
bullets.suggestion: Automated retraining of a Bedrock source-relevancy model via EventBridge triggers with decision gates to skip redundant runs; added CloudWatch + X-Ray tracing and SNS failure alerts.

bullets.quote: Developing automated training for PhysTwin, a physics-based
bullets.issue: Describes team/context, not the candidate's contribution or method.
bullets.suggestion: Clarify what the candidate built for automated training (pipeline, scheduler, tooling) and lead with that; keep 'ICLR submission' as credibility anchor.

bullets.quote: Built a Python pipeline linking AnyGrasp multi-camera
bullets.issue: Full model ID string is parser/screener noise; benefit phrasing is vague.
bullets.suggestion: Built a Python pipeline feeding AnyGrasp multi-camera grasp candidates into Open3D-rendered views for a Qwen3-VL model, letting researchers isolate scene components and iterate faster.

bullets.quote: Cut research-environment setup time 30% via UV
bullets.issue: Pytest/psutil clause is a separate idea; bullet mixes setup speed with bottleneck profiling.
bullets.suggestion: Cut research-environment setup time 30% with uv dependency pinning and Docker for identical environments; added psutil timing/memory monitoring and Pytest tests to locate bottlenecks.

bullets.quote: Co-founded and scaled a 110+ member campus
bullets.suggestion: Co-founded and scaled a 110+ member campus product studio shipping 5 live products, organizing teams through agile practices.

bullets.quote: Sustained 20,000+ site visits within the initial
bullets.issue: Strong metric; sentence order is awkward ('Sustained ... through developing').
bullets.suggestion: Built Prisma-based SQL querying with Redis caching for Tortuga, a class scheduler, sustaining 20,000+ site visits in its first 30 days with reduced database load and latency.

bullets.quote: Building a work-in-progress integration of a RAG
bullets.issue: Honest WIP scoping is good; 93% satisfaction needs sample context; bullet over-bolded.
bullets.suggestion: Building (WIP) a RAG meal-suggestion feature for the official UMD app using GPT-4o mini over ChromaDB + SentenceBERT search on scraped recipes; 93% satisfaction among internal testers.

bullets.quote: Implemented a C++-based order book simulation on
bullets.issue: 'contract-based plug-and-play design' is vague; no scale or result.
bullets.suggestion: Implemented a C++ order book simulation replaying historical IEX data, with a pluggable interface enforcing correctness contracts so multiple matching/storage approaches can be compared.

bullets.quote: Wrote and evaluated paginated hash-based data storage
bullets.issue: 'evaluated' used twice; outcome of drift evaluation not stated.
bullets.suggestion: Wrote paginated hash-based storage for live order book data with in-memory LFU caching of frequently requested tickers, validated for drift against IEX historical book data.

bullets.quote: Designed and assessed the performance of a
bullets.issue: Good systems signal but no finding; reader wants which approach won and why.
bullets.suggestion: Clarify the benchmark outcome (Adaptive LSM vs. B+ tree) if known; otherwise tighten: Benchmarked a time-based adaptive LSM vs. B+ tree log store using rdtscp timing and Linux perf counters.

structure.change: Move CERTIFICATIONS below TECHNICAL SKILLS (or merge as one line into Skills).
structure.rationale: Experience should start in the top third; the cert is a keyword hit regardless of position and not a headline win.

structure.change: Fit contact info on one line (shorten location to 'New York, NY', drop the LinkedIn numeric suffix if a vanity URL exists).
structure.rationale: Wrapped header lines can split fields during extraction; one line parses and skims cleaner.

structure.change: Add the same spacing before EXPERIENCE as before other section headings.
structure.rationale: Visual inconsistency; EXPERIENCE currently butts against the certification block.

structure.change: Recategorize skills (IaC vs CI/CD, messaging vs observability) and surface techs used in bullets (PostgreSQL, Redis, Kinesis, Bedrock) in Skills; drop items with no evidence unless the candidate can defend them.
structure.rationale: Skills section is what keyword matchers weight; it should mirror demonstrated experience accurately.

structure.change: Limit bold to ≤2 anchors per bullet, preferably the metric and one core technology.
structure.rationale: Current bolding is so dense it no longer guides the eye to the wins.

top3: Cut every bullet to ≤2 lines with ≤2 bold anchors and lead with the result (especially the 65% and 34% wins).
Fix ATS hygiene: real phone number, one consistent month format, 'Digital Badge' out of the location column, correct skill categories.
Clarify: the concurrent 'Present' roles vs. the Redmond AWS internship and the contract employer, and give the AWS intern role a concrete what/why.
